MoinPDF Search Regular

Generated from scratch by scripts/build-search-font.py using fonttools.
No third-party glyph outlines or source fonts are incorporated.
The glyph contours have zero area. This font is only for invisible, selectable
Unicode search text in PDFs, and must never be used for visible replacement text.
Each supported Unicode code point has a separate glyph ID for exact ToUnicode
mapping. Rendering mode 3 keeps the search layer invisible.
